get_candles.description: Get a Bitstamp market's price candles (OHLC: open, high, low, close and volume) of 1 minute to 3 days each, the latest or between two times, oldest first, with the change across them.
get_candles.name: get_candles

parameters.description: The market, such as BTC/USD. A symbol chained from an earlier step works too, written as btcusd, BTC/USD or btcusd-perp.
parameters.name: market

parameters.description: How long each candle is.
parameters.name: step

parameters.description: How many candles, up to 1,000. Leave empty for 100, or, with both a start and an end, for every candle between them.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: The first candle is the one holding this time. Leave empty for the latest candles.
parameters.name: start

parameters.description: The last candle is the one holding this time. On its own, gives the candles up to it.
parameters.name: end

parameters.description: Leave out the candle still forming, so every candle is complete.
parameters.name: exclude_current

get_candles.result_str_template: Got {bitstamp_get_candles,count} candles, {bitstamp_get_candles,percent_change}% from first to last.

close.description: The last price in the candle.

high.description: The highest price in the candle.

low.description: The lowest price in the candle.

open.description: The first price in the candle.

time.description: When the candle starts, in ISO 8601 (UTC).

timestamp.description: When the candle starts, in Unix seconds.

volume.description: How much was traded in the candle, in the base currency.

change.description: The last close minus the first open.

high.description: The highest price across the candles.

low.description: The lowest price across the candles.

market.description: The market's Bitstamp symbol, such as 'btcusd' for BTC/USD or 'btcusd-perp' for the BTC/USD perpetual. Every action that takes a market accepts it.

market_name.description: The market's name, such as 'BTC/USD' or 'BTC/USD-PERP'.

percent_change.description: The change as a percentage of the first open.

step.description: Each candle's length, such as '1 hour'.

volume.description: Everything traded across the candles, in the base currency.

get_eur_usd_rate.description: Get the rates Bitstamp changes euros and US dollars at: what one euro costs in dollars, what it gives, and the gap between them.
get_eur_usd_rate.name: get_eur_usd_rate
get_eur_usd_rate.result_str_template: One euro costs {bitstamp_get_eur_usd_rate,buy} US dollars and gives {bitstamp_get_eur_usd_rate,sell}.

buy.description: US dollars Bitstamp asks for one euro, when buying euros.

sell.description: US dollars Bitstamp gives for one euro, when selling euros.

spread_percent.description: The gap between them as a percentage of the mid.

description: Read Bitstamp's public market data: the price and last 24 hours of any market or all of them at once, this hour's trading, the order book, recent trades, price candles, the markets and currencies Bitstamp lists, its EUR/USD rate, and for its perpetual futures the funding rate, past funding and index hours. Start a workflow when a price crosses a level or a large trade goes through. No account or API key required.

output.trade_id: Bitstamp's ID for the trade, as text.
